hook: orphan 混裝｜B區清倉籃：把還在主庫晃蕩的 orphan 裝進籃子，標籤要用中文義核。
script: acerbity/acquisitive/acrobat/adduce 先入籃。清倉廣播：這不是亂打折，是差集點名；每個詞報到時大聲念釋義，防止魚目混珠。

members.senseAnchor: a sharp bitterness; a sharp sour taste
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-尖酸刻薄: acerbity walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-尖酸刻薄」出場：acerbity 一上場梗就黏住——尖酸刻薄。

members.senseAnchor: eager to acquire and possess things especially material possessions or ideas
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-貪婪的: acquisitive walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-貪婪的」出場：acquisitive 一上場梗就黏住——貪婪的。

members.senseAnchor: an athlete who performs acts requiring skill and agility and coordination
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-特技演員: acrobat walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-特技演員」出場：acrobat 一上場梗就黏住——特技演員。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-舉出；引: adduce walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-舉出；引」出場：adduce 一上場梗就黏住——舉出；引證。

members.senseAnchor: someone who believes and helps to spread the doctrine of another; sticking fast
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-連貫的；: adherent walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-連貫的；」出場：adherent 一上場梗就黏住——連貫的；一致的。

members.senseAnchor: close at the end of a session; break from a meeting or gathering
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-延期: adjourn walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-延期」出場：adjourn 一上場梗就黏住——延期。

related.antonyms: advance, deposit, engage, get up, turn out

members.senseAnchor: to make something impure or weaker
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-v. 摻: adulterate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-v. 摻」出場：adulterate 一上場梗就黏住——v. 摻雜。

members.senseAnchor: associated by chance and not an integral part; - Frederick W. Robertson
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-外來的；: adventitious walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-外來的；」出場：adventitious 一上場梗就黏住——外來的；偶然的。

members.senseAnchor: a public promotion of some product or service; give heed (to)
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-留意；注: advert walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-留意；注」出場：advert 一上場梗就黏住——留意；注意。

related.synonyms: ad, advertisement, advertizement, advertising, advertizing, attend

members.senseAnchor: expose to fresh air; aerate (sewage) so as to favor the growth of organisms that decompose organic matter
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-充氣: aerate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-充氣」出場：aerate 一上場梗就黏住——充氣。

members.senseAnchor: a pass to a receiver downfield from the passer; an electrical device that sends or receives radio or television signals
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-空中的: aerial walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-空中的」出場：aerial 一上場梗就黏住——空中的。

members.senseAnchor: have an effect upon; act physically on; have an effect upon
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-做作的；: affected walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-做作的；」出場：affected 一上場梗就黏住——做作的；不自然的。

related.synonyms: affect, impact, touch, involve, regard, feign

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-感情的: affective walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-感情的」出場：affective 一上場梗就黏住——感情的。

members.senseAnchor: a social or business relationship; the act of becoming formally connected or joined
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-隸屬: affiliation walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-隸屬」出場：affiliation 一上場梗就黏住——隸屬。

members.senseAnchor: a state of great suffering and distress due to adversity; a condition of suffering or distress due to ill health
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-折磨；苦: affliction walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-折磨；苦」出場：affliction 一上場梗就黏住——折磨；苦難。

members.senseAnchor: a deliberately offensive act or something producing the effect of deliberate disrespect; treat, mention, or speak to rudely
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-羞辱；侮: affront walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-羞辱；侮」出場：affront 一上場梗就黏住——羞辱；侮辱。

pitfalls: 場景名牌分義，勿因同籃硬串字根
